217:11440.en: 「Of course. You're young, so do your best.」

217:11477.en: 「Then shall we volunteer to help everyone, too?」

217:11542.en: 「The game's paused, so let's discuss $$ヒビキ$$'s training plan.」

217:11631.en: 「Oh! The quiet type is speeding up!」

217:11666.en: 「Players, do your best with the Reactors toward the end of 'Super Robot Wars Z'.」

217:11773.en: 「The game's paused, so let's discuss his training plan.」

217:11945.en: 「Show some drive. Enough to clear this game, no resets, no stopping.」

217:12050.en: 「Heh... I expect much of you. Hurry back.」

217:12175.en: 「Pausing? Perfect. Let the player pick, me or you.」

217:12258.en: 「Pick me for plenty of service no stiff lady teacher offers.」

217:12350.en: 「Then think up service you can offer.」

217:12420.en: 「That's that. Decide who you pick before resuming.」

217:12699.en: 「Man and machine as one...! I can!」

217:12883.en: 「Even alone, I have to do this...!」

217:12994.en: 「Let's do this, $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$...!」

217:13056.en: 「My consciousness spreads\nthrough all of $$ジェミニオン$$...!」

217:13105.en: 「Making lawlessness the law,\nmaking the infinite finite...!」

217:13330.en: 「If I can't end it in one strike...!」

217:13423.en: 「$$バアル$$! I'll be your natural enemy!」

217:13536.en: 「This fight won't do Earth any good!」

217:13575.en: 「This is the human power you scorn!」

217:13614.en: 「Past the despair you speak of,\nI'm still alive!」

217:13708.en: 「A man who denies the future\ndoesn't suit the name $$赤い彗星$$!」

217:13802.en: 「You'll answer for making\n$$千鳥$$ and $$宗介$$ suffer!」

217:13937.en: 「I'm taking Miss $$スズネ$$ back,\n$$アムブリエル$$!」

217:14027.en: 「You and Miss $$スズネ$$ are one!\nFeel it, $$アムブリエル$$!」

217:14143.en: 「There are plenty of humans\nwho reject your rule!」

217:14200.en: 「I will take Earth back from you!」

217:14272.en: 「That smirk ends here,\n$$サルディアス$$!」

217:14352.en: 「You'll atone for your\ndirty tricks, $$ギルター$$!」

217:14401.en: 「$$尸刻$$!\nI won't be swallowed by your aura!」

217:14479.en: 「If nothing can be done,\nI'll do it with my own hands...!」

217:14567.en: 「Even if I'm an inferior Reactor,\nthere's a way to fight!」

217:14622.en: 「A good chance!\nI'll learn how to use the $$スフィア$$!」

217:14679.en: 「I won't lose to a being that only\nspreads hatred!」

217:14728.en: 「$$バルビエル$$!\nYour poison won't work on me!」

217:14816.en: 「$$尸空#pilot$$!\nI'll break your shroud of death!」

217:14871.en: 「If I take him down,\nthe Empire's army will collapse!」

217:14967.en: 「I'll take you on,\n$$エルーナルーナ$$!」

217:15016.en: 「Earth is not your playground!\nI'll teach you that!」

217:15128.en: 「$$ヴィルダーク$$!\nPower without justice is violence!」

217:15179.en: 「I won't give you my life\nor this $$スフィア$$!」

217:15232.en: 「I can't forgive what you did\nto $$セツコ$$ and the others!」

217:15295.en: 「You mistake the $$御使い$$ power\nfor your own, it seems!」

217:15354.en: 「If the chosen ones lose to us,\nyou'll lose face, won't you!」

217:15446.en: 「I decide my own fate!\nI'll never hand it to you!」

217:15558.en: 「A hard-head like you has no right\nto decide humanity's future!」

217:15615.en: 「$$ティティ$$ is gone!\nAll I see is humanity's enemy!」

217:15676.en: 「I'll avenge the anguish of lives\nyou took for your pleasure!」

217:15839.en: 「I won't give you any more joy!」

217:15945.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Future, universe, even me,\nnone of it goes to you!」
